name: QuantumLauncher [anylinux]
description:
QuantumLauncher is an open-source, lightweight Minecraft launcher designed for simplicity, security, and speed. It offers streamlined management for Minecraft versions, mod loaders, and community modpacks.

Features:
- Fast instance creation with support for Vanilla, Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, and Quilt
- Direct searching and one-click installation of Modrinth and CurseForge modpacks
- Isolated game directory per instance preventing mod conflicts and configuration corruption
- Automatic Java runtime management and customizable memory allocation
- Clean, responsive user interface without superfluous telemetry or advertisements

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
